description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule diff behavior on uninitialized or removed submodules. It includes setup, modification, and removal of submodules, and verifies the diff outputs.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a Git repository, commits them, and returns the short hash of the commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message indicating the files being committed.
